why: T49: the connectivity prior was guarded on `and bond_orders`, so it was skipped exactly when the decode kept zero bonds — the only case it can still rescue. This records the population that guard produced and the before/after decode on a synthetic zero-bond cloud.
code_change: molmetal/molmetal_lam/lam_chem/cfm_decoder_yuelbond.py decode(): `if self.connectivity_prior and bond_orders:` -> `if self.connectivity_prior:`. _bridge_components already handles an empty bond list (parent = identity, one component per heavy atom, candidates from edge_index), so nothing else changed.

population.definition: n_frags_raw > 1 AND largest_frag_frac == 1/n_frags_raw (every fragment a single atom)
population.note: counted on the shipped pool, not re-decoded; the c7 run's own columns are the evidence

synthetic_decode.cloud: 5 atoms: Pt at the centre, 4 C on a tetrahedron of circumradius 1.9 A
synthetic_decode.why_this_geometry: all ten pairs are inside the 3.5 A candidate cutoff (C-C 3.10 A) and every pair is above the 1.0 A clamp, so the cloud isolates the prior from both

head_logits.unsure: NO_BOND 2.0, BOND_SINGLE 1.0, rest -10.0 (argmax is NO_BOND; max non-NO_BOND 1.0 >= min_logit 0.0)

zero_bond_connected.claim: a zero-bond cloud decodes to one fragment when the prior is on

off_is_unchanged.measured: 0 bridges, 0 bonds, 5 fragments — the branch is not entered at all, so the path is the old one by construction

prior_still_defers.claim: a head that says NO_BOND by a wide margin is not overridden
prior_still_defers.measured: certain head -> 0 bridges with the prior on
prior_still_defers.why_it_matters: removing the `and bond_orders` guard must not turn the prior into an unconditional bond generator; connectivity_prior_min_logit is the deference knob and this pins it

c7_redecode.claim: the 302 all-single-atom rows stop being all-single-atom
c7_redecode.why: needs a re-decode of the c7 pool against its checkpoint, which is T29's run. Recording it as UNMEASURED rather than inferring it from the synthetic case.

honest_limits: The bridged molecule is chemically arbitrary: a bridge is added as BOND_SINGLE regardless of the head's class, so [CH3][Pt]([CH3])([CH3])[CH3] is 'the prior ran', not 'the molecule is right'.
The 302-row population is measured; the effect on it is not. The synthetic cloud shows the mechanism, not the size of the fix.

The guard removal does not touch the case where the head is confident NO_BOND, and that case is the majority of the c7 pool's zero-bond rows only if their logits are below min_logit — untested against the real logits.
